description: Personal Management is practical money and time management: saving for a goal, running a thirteen-week budget, understanding investing, insurance and credit, managing your time for a week, planning a project, and exploring the cost of a career.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: A family savings goal
requirements.summary: Choosing a major family purchase, writing a savings plan and a shopping strategy.

children.title: Career costs
children.summary: Researching a career’s education and costs and how to cover them.

requirements.title: A thirteen-week budget
requirements.summary: Preparing a budget, comparing expected income and expenses, and tracking actual results.

requirements.title: Money concepts
requirements.summary: Discussing several money concepts, such as the emotions around money, buyer’s remorse and charitable giving.

requirements.title: Saving and investing
requirements.summary: Saving versus investing, return and risk, simple and compound interest, and diversification.

requirements.title: Kinds of investments
requirements.summary: Common investments such as stocks, mutual funds, bonds, certificates of deposit and savings accounts.

requirements.title: Insurance
requirements.summary: Common kinds of insurance and what they protect against.

requirements.title: Loans and credit
requirements.summary: Loans and interest rates, ways to borrow, credit and debit cards, credit reports and reducing debt.

requirements.title: Time management
requirements.summary: A to-do list, a seven-day schedule and diary, and reviewing what worked.

requirements.title: A project plan
requirements.summary: A written plan for a project, with goal, timeline, resources and budget.
